title: Internship position | Wholesale Banking | Corporate Sector Coverage NL
full_description:
Amsterdam, Netherlands
ING is a global bank with a strong European base. Our purpose is to empower people to stay a step ahead in life and in business. With 38 million customers and almost 60,000 employees, our priority is to give our customers a superior experience and access to our sector expertise and network.
Within ING, Wholesale Banking is catered to our Corporate Clients to which we provide a full strategic product offering: specialised lending, tailored corporate finance, debt & equity market solutions, sustainable finance solutions, payments & cash management, and trade & finance services.
As part of the Corporate Sector Coverage NL team you engage in strategic dialogues with CEO, CFO and Treasury teams of the largest multinational corporates (revenue >€250m) in the European market.
As an Intern in the Corporate Sector Coverage NL team you will gain knowledge through working on projects alongside senior relationship managers, analysts, sector teams and specialist product teams to provide our clients with a full spectrum of products (lending, capital markets & advisory, financial markets & transaction services).
Key responsibilities include:
Perform (financial) analyses on clients, sectors, and peers in an international environment
Responsible for collecting client/sector information and analysing this information for solution offering processes
Active participation in the preparation of financial models and client pitch books
As part of a deal team, originate and coordinate new business, monitor profitability and assist with the realisation of the teams and clients’ objectives
Build relationships, knowledge and experience that will open doors to future career opportunities within ING
Through an internship in ING’s sector team you’ll have the opportunity to get to work in a leading European institution, a dedicated sector team and the solutions it provides. You get to experience what it is to be a full-time corporate banker.
Who Are We Looking For
We are looking for an ambitious young professional who is keen to contribute to further strengthen our leading position in the European market. The ideal candidate has strong analytical and communication skills and is able to deal with a broad range of stakeholders at various seniority levels. You are result oriented, proactive and have the ambition to come up with solutions.
Enrolled in a (University) Bachelor‘s degree, and/ or Master’s degree during the time of internship
Excellent analytical and communication skills
Demonstrate strong interest in financial services
A reliable team player who is highly motivated and eager to learn
Excellent verbal and written skills both in English and Dutch
Display honesty, prudence, and responsibility as part of the ING Orange Code
• Internship allowance
• Your own work laptop
• Personal growth and challenging work with endless possibilities
• An informal working environment with innovative colleagues
Want to apply directly? Please upload your CV and motivation letter by clicking the “Apply” button. Assessments take place on a rolling basis, and we aim to get back to applicants as soon as possible.
ING is a global bank with a strong European base. We have more than 60,000 employees globally and serve over 39.5 million customers. We offer Wholesale Banking services in 35 markets across Europe, the Middle East and Africa (EMEA), the Americas, and Asia Pacific (APAC).
ING’s strategy is built around our purpose to empower people to stay a step ahead in life and in business. We aim to fulfil this by providing superior value to our clients and putting sustainability at the heart of what we do.
In a world that’s constantly changing, we’re digital and sustainability pioneers, adapting to the trends impacting our business, and the businesses of our clients. When it comes to sustainability, ING facilitates and finances society’s shift to a low-carbon future and pioneer innovative forms of finance to support a better world. Therefore, sustainability forms an integral part of ING’s strategy.
ING’s vision is to unlock our people’s full potential through our inclusive culture where everyone has the opportunity to develop and have impact for our customers and society. To achieve this vision, our policies support diversity, equity, and inclusion. As an equal opportunity employer, we do not tolerate discrimination of any kind with regard to age, gender, gender identity, cultural background, experience, religion, race, ethnicity, disability, family responsibilities, sexual orientation, social origin, or any other status protected by applicable law. If you require any assistance or if we can accommodate you in any way when participating in our application and/or interview process, please email the recruiting contact listed for the relevant position. We will be happy to work with you to ensure a fair and accessible process. Read more about our commitment to diversity, inclusion and belonging here.
